Help.title: How to use
Help.desc: Add your resume once, provide the job details, and review a tailored version before using it.
Help.s1d: Enter your Gemini key during onboarding or in Settings. Generation requires an internet connection and uses your key, which is stored in this browser.
Help.s2d: Upload a PDF with selectable text. The app extracts and organizes your experience, education, and skills to use as the basis for future versions.
Help.s3d: Paste the job description and choose the resume language. The AI compares the requirements with your base resume and creates a targeted version, a match analysis, strengths and gaps, and outreach messages.
Help.s4d: Check all details before using them: AI can make mistakes. Applications are saved in this browser; you can generate again when needed and export a backup in Settings.

Cookie.message: We only use local storage in your browser (no first-party cookies). Google Fonts and the Gemini API (with your key) load from third parties.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1h: 1. Your data stays in your browser
Privacy.s1b: Personalize My CV has no server and no database. Your base resume, generated applications and settings live only in your browser''s localStorage, under pmcv:* keys. Nothing is sent to our servers — because there are none.
Privacy.s2b: We use no first-party cookies and no trackers. The cookie notice exists for transparency: we only store your consent choice (pmcv:consent) and preferences (language, theme) in local storage.
Privacy.s3b: Two external connections happen straight from your browser: Google Fonts (loads the Roboto font) and the Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com), called with YOUR key to generate resumes. Google''s privacy policies apply.
Privacy.s4b: The key is yours and stays obfuscated in the browser (secure-ls — not a vault). Use a key with quota limits, never share it, and revoke it at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey if you think it leaked.
Privacy.s5b: Access, correction, portability and deletion are all in your hands. Export a backup in Settings for portability; delete applications, clear the base or remove the key for deletion. Legal basis: your consent.
Privacy.s6b: Privacy questions? Reach filipeleonelbatista via LinkedIn in the footer. This policy may change; the date at the top marks the current version.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.s1b: An AI resume tailor, 100% static and free. You register your base CV as PDF and generate optimized versions per job (PDF, match score, email and message). No account, no server: everything in your browser.
Terms.s2b: This project is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only: you may use, study, modify and distribute it, as long as derivative works stay free and open under the same license.
Terms.s3b: The Gemini key is personal. Google API usage costs are yours; set quotas and never use someone else''s key without permission.
Terms.s4b: AI can make mistakes (dates, translations, scores). Review every resume before sending it to recruiters. The app is provided as is, without warranties of any kind.
Terms.s5b: Don''t use the app to bypass Google API limits, spam recruiters or generate unlawful content. Respect Google''s terms of use.
Terms.s6b: Contact channel via LinkedIn in the footer. We may update these terms; continued use after changes means agreement.
